To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a stable I-type NB cell line was established that expresses N- and S-typemarkers and that can be induced along N- and/or S-type pathways.
NUB-7 is an I-type human neuroblastic cell line that expresses N- and S-cell markers and that can be induced along N- and/or S-cell lineages by cyclic AMP and retinoid, respectively.
the NUB- 7 NB cell line is composed of a bipotentially differentiated I-type cell that can be induced to undergo differentiation along N- and/or S-type lineages.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of the cell of origin in neuroblastomas.
the identification and characterization of a bipotentially differentiated progenitor cell in NB.
the development and characterization of a stable I-type NB cell line and the use of these cells to study the regulation of N- and/or S-type phenotypic expression.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

NUB-7 is an NB cell line that expresses features of both N- (neuroblasts) and S- (Schwann cells) type cell lines, and that is inducible along these cell lineages by dibutyryl cyclic adenosine monophosphate and retinoic acids, respectively.
NUB-7 cells are of the I-type, and are bipotential for the N- and S-types of NB cells.
NUB-7 is an N/S bipotential cell line that can be used as an experimental model for the study of the development of NB.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the NUB- 7 cell line is the first stable, human I-type neuroblastoma cell culture model.
the NUB- 7 cell line represents a stable I-type NB cell line which is inducible along both N- and 5-type cell lineages.
the NUB- 7 cell line represents a human neuroblastoma tumor that is composed of a stable I-type cell population that is capable of differentiation along both N- and the S-type cell line.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the NUB- 7 cell line represents a new stable human NB cell line with a unique I-type phenotype.
the I-type cell is the progenitor cell that can give rise to N-type and S-type cells and that the NUB- 7 cell line is a good representative of this cell.
we have established a new human NB cell line (NUB-7), which is composed principally of I cells, the progenitor cell type for N- and S-cells.
